craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of the sealed proof — utsāha as each consequence collapses and the maker stands. Haimed-at-Lord; no-fault-shakes; this-shall-stand (rhyme L3s); kevalam-scope closes disputation per UNC. Rejected: (a) stand→hold → killed: rhyme + stand stands. Read aloud: THIS-rea-SON, LAID up-ON the-LORD … THIS-shall-STAND.

lines: This reason, laid upon the Lord by self-entrusted hand,
no fault of logic shakes — nor rival's: this shall stand.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sa eṣa hetuḥ parameśvaraṃ prati prayujyamānaḥ

reads_against.argmap: Aimed at whom — shaken by what? → The hetu stands aimed at the Lord; rivals answered, disputation closed.
c1_essence: The svabhāva-view's consequences pressed: desired-by-all yet body-changes by nature; occurrence without union; needlessness fitting neither spirit nor mind; no reunion yet rebirth; mokṣa collapsed into nature; compassion-acts forcing passion-exhaustion doctrine (vv46-51).
The siddhānta sealed: nature-view abandoned as unjust, bodies famously sentient-maker-prior, arrangement-difference the flawless proof, the hetu aimed at Parameśvara unshaken (vv52-54).
